frozen_implementation_decisions.decision: title condition read as case-insensitive substring plus expected-token coverage >= 0.85, with the full-token-set Jaccard logged but not used as the primary test
frozen_implementation_decisions.declared: before any field determination was authored, in resolve_identity.py docstring and raw/identity_resolution.json
frozen_implementation_decisions.effect_if_reversed: identity_resolution_recall becomes 0.0; Parts 2 and 3 remain INCONCLUSIVE; the overall MEASUREMENT_INVALID is unchanged because it rests on gate 1
frozen_implementation_decisions.reason: prereg 4.1(2) reads 'matches the expected title substring (case-insensitive, fuzzy threshold >= 0.85 Jaccard on token sets)'. A full-token-set Jaccard of 0.85 between a 1-2 token expected title and a real arXiv title of 8-15 tokens is arithmetically unsatisfiable, which would make the frozen rule incapable of ever returning CORRECTLY_RESOLVED and would silently convert the whole experiment to INCONCLUSIVE. Both statistics are logged so the decision is auditable and reversible.

frozen_implementation_decisions.decision: an expected_authors list of ['TBD'] is recorded as condition C3 pass=null with reason C3_author_unevaluable_TBD, not as pass=false
frozen_implementation_decisions.declared: before any field determination was authored, in resolve_identity.py
frozen_implementation_decisions.effect_if_reversed: none on any verdict; the PC already fails its pass criterion
frozen_implementation_decisions.reason: an unevaluable condition is a different object from a failed condition, and recording it as a failure would fabricate negative identity evidence about an artifact that was never checked against an author list

frozen_implementation_decisions.decision: an artifact that is retrieved but fails the identity conjunction is emitted as AMBIGUOUS and scored UNMEASURED; NOT_LOCATED is reserved for no artifact at all
frozen_implementation_decisions.declared: before any field determination was authored, in resolve_identity.py
frozen_implementation_decisions.effect_if_reversed: would recreate the parent packet's five false NOT_FOUND rows
frozen_implementation_decisions.reason: this is the parent packet's exact defect: a retrieved-but-wrong artifact was converted into a negative. prereg 4.2 step 6 and spec.json UNMEASURED_NOT_NEGATIVE both require the two states to be distinguished

reproduction.determinism: given identical HTTP responses the pipeline is fully deterministic apart from the generated_at / generated_at_utc wall-clock stamps: no model calls, no sampling, no seeds. The one non-reproducible element is arXiv's own corpus, which changes as new versions appear.
reproduction.entry_point: cd research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-36306525220 && python3 resolve_identity.py && python3 recheck_and_snowball.py && python3 run_controls.py && python3 extract_spans.py && python3 field_determinations.py && python3 build_table.py && python3 build_result.py && python3 validate_packet.py
reproduction.two_pass_note: build_result.py is run twice by design: once to emit result.json and provenance.json, then again after report.md is authored so that report.md's sha256 is pinned in result.json.artifacts. The second run is deterministic and changes no other field.
